title.en: Construction aggregate names the sections; main cylinder seal kit marks keeps the printed cells
title.zh: 《构造骨料》只提供章节，main cylinder seal kit marks仍用已印格子

description.en: The main cylinder seal kit marks note follows the outline of Construction aggregate. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists eight main-cylinder seal kits. The marks are not interchangeable spellings of one size. No pump model and no service life are printed.
description.zh: main cylinder seal kit marks这篇笔记顺着《构造骨料》的大纲写。河北品锦机械列出八套主油缸密封。这些标记不是同一尺寸的不同写法。没有印泵型号，也没有印寿命。

h1.en: How Construction aggregate arranges a note that only repeats main cylinder seal kit marks
h1.zh: 《构造骨料》怎样安排一篇只重复main cylinder seal kit marks的笔记

directAnswer.en: For main cylinder seal kit marks, copy the printed fragments and ignore any urge to borrow a figure from Construction aggregate. Construction aggregate only lends its headings. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists eight main-cylinder seal kits. The marks are not interchangeable spellings of one size. No pump model and no service life are printed.
directAnswer.zh: 写main cylinder seal kit marks时，只抄已印片段，不要从来源页《构造骨料》借数字。《构造骨料》只出借标题。 河北品锦机械列出八套主油缸密封。这些标记不是同一尺寸的不同写法。没有印泵型号，也没有印寿命。

body.en: Use “Specifications” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. φ63 and φ80 use a diameter mark. 80×125, 90×140, 95×140 and 100×150 use two numbers and a times sign. 90–160 uses a dash. 461K is a kit code. The page does not define the two numbers as bore and rod. it only says to confirm the kit against the cylinder bore and rod. φ80 is also a mixing seal, a swing-cylinder seal and an S-tube small-end seal. 100 / 125 mm is a pipe cell on four pumps. None of those is the main-cylinder row 80×125 or 100×150. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 用“规格”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 φ63 和 φ80 用直径标记。80×125、90×140、95×140 和 100×150 用两个数字加乘号。90–160 用连接号。461K 是套件代号。页面没有把两个数字定义成缸径和活塞杆，只要求对照油缸缸径和活塞杆核对套件。 φ80 同时也是搅拌密封、摆缸密封和 S 管小端密封。100 / 125 mm 是四台泵的管子格子。它们都不是主油缸那一行的 80×125 或 100×150。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: Use “History” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Copy one mark only. Say which of the eight rows you checked. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists eight main-cylinder seal kits. The marks are not interchangeable spellings of one size. No pump model and no service life are printed. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 用“历史”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 只抄一个标记。写明核对的是八行里的哪一行。 河北品锦机械列出八套主油缸密封。这些标记不是同一尺寸的不同写法。没有印泵型号，也没有印寿命。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Modern production”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. No. They are two printed rows. The page does not expand 461K. Diameter is a missing field for that code. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 来源页目录里有“现代生产”。本节借用这个名字，然后复述已经印出的片段。 不是。它们是印出的两行。 页面没有展开 461K。这个代号的直径是缺字段。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: The heading “Recycled materials” is structural. What it is allowed to carry is the wording already on the row for this note. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Unprinted cells stay unprinted. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Construction_aggregate
body.zh: 标题“来源章节：Recycled materials”只起骨架作用。它能够携带的，是这篇笔记对应那一行已经印出的文字。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 没有印出的格子保持不印。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Construction_aggregate

question.en: Can the outline heading “History” rename main cylinder seal kit marks?
question.zh: 大纲标题“历史”可以改掉main cylinder seal kit marks的名称吗？

answer.en: No. They are two printed rows. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。它们是印出的两行。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Does “Modern production” on Construction aggregate fill a blank on the main cylinder seal kit marks row?
question.zh: 《构造骨料》上的“现代生产”会填上main cylinder seal kit marks的空白格子吗？

answer.en: The page does not expand 461K. Diameter is a missing field for that code. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 页面没有展开 461K。这个代号的直径是缺字段。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Why is Construction aggregate not a source of extra ratings for main cylinder seal kit marks?
question.zh: 为什么《构造骨料》不能给main cylinder seal kit marks增加额定值？

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
